summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Russell Top 200 ETF (IWL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell Top 200 index, a market-cap-weighted index of the 200 largest US companies. IWL was launched on Sep 22, 2009 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: IWL is an equity ETF with a total of 205 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 9.32%, Apple at 8.54%, Microsoft at 6.60%, Alphabet at 6.30%, and Amazon.com at 4.17%.
